svg.title: Industrial ownership
svg.desc: Sable Harbor, LLC — Sacramento, California — Develops industrial software, operates resource businesses, and advises clients.; Sable Harbor Industrial Holdings, Inc. — Location not recorded — Owns Sable Harbor’s mining and transport subsidiaries.; Pale Sun Inc. — Location not recorded — Develops uranium operations and owns Red Wash Mining.; American Resource Utility, Inc. — Taylor, Wyoming — Provides rail, truck, terminal, and warehouse services for industrial customers.; Red Wash Mining, LLC — Sweetwater County, Wyoming — Operates the Red Wash uranium mine.; Blood, Sweat & Tears Railway Company — Taylor, Wyoming — Hauls industrial freight by rail between Wamsutter and Taylor.
